Some narrative repetitions also render "ng/mL" as "mg/mL"; the table headers print "Apparent digoxin, ng/ml" (p24, p25) and the narrative prints "0.71 ng/mL to 4.36 ng/mL" (p24), fixing the unit as ng/ml. Discussion (p26): "our data clearly show significant interference of Chan Su and Lu-Shen-Wan with both the Roche and Beckman assays for digoxin. Although the magnitude of interference is less than with the FPIA, the falsely elevated values may cause a clinically significant bias in interpretations of serum digoxin concentrations." Digoxin therapeutic range given as 0.8-1.9 ng/mL (p22, p25).
